composite_prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: S07 riverside NIGHT full composite C, matching the existing DAY composite.
Input Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET. Change ONLY time of day into a quiet readable early night. Preserve the exact camera, composition, tree trunk and branch structure, tree canopy outline, all grass tufts and flowers, three pale stones, bridge arch and masonry shapes, curving path, riverbank boundaries, horizon, water brush marks, crop and native dimensions.
Use muted dusty-teal and warm-grey night sky and cool shadows; the path and bridge remain visible in soft ambient night light. Water is slightly deeper dusty teal, still a matte gouache surface. No actual light source is visible and none should be added: no moon, stars, lamps, lanterns, fireflies, people, animals or bright sparkles. No magical glow or reflections. Do not add foliage, buildings or extra rocks. The rightmost 30 percent and broad bottom area retain their low detail.
Maintain gouache picture-book illustration, visible strokes and dry-brush edges, slightly wobbly hand-drawn colored-pencil outlines, simplified shapes and slightly imperfect perspective, seven muted color families (cream, warm grey, walnut brown, sage green, dusty teal, faded plum, ochre), cool-tinted shadows, few props, one focal point, matte paper texture.
NEGATIVE: glow, bloom, light rays, god rays, lens flare, bokeh, depth of field blur, gold filigree, ornate carvings, glossy or plastic surfaces, hyper-detailed clutter, photorealism, symmetrical fantasy composition, wisteria, text, letters, numbers, UI, labels, blank plaques, frames, borders.
cleanplate_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: S07 NIGHT raw cleanplate B_all for true extracted foreground grass and tree-canopy layers.
Input Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET. Remove ONLY the following:
1. All leaves of the foreground tree canopy across the upper-left/top edge. Keep the main tree trunk and thick bare branch structure in their original positions and fill behind removed leaves with the original painted sky.
2. The foreground grass tufts along the lower-left riverbank and beside the curving path, including the small wildflower stalks that grow among those tufts. Fill behind them with the plausible plain earth path/bank or water immediately behind the specific blades.
Keep the three pale stones and their moss, the static tree trunk/branches, bridge masonry, every riverbank boundary, background distant vegetation, path position and sky/clouds unchanged. IMPORTANT: retain the water itself and its existing painted brush marks; do not erase the river, replace it with land, or invent water waves. Water will later use an exact region mask from this original composite, not a regenerated ripple image.
Keep NIGHT lighting, color, camera, crop and same native dimensions; preserve unrelated pixels as closely as possible. Maintain the matte gouache medium, visible dry-brush strokes, slightly wobbly colored-pencil outline and muted seven-family palette.
No new objects, people, animals, text, numbers, UI, plaques, borders, glow, bloom, bright sparkles or photorealism.
The target is NIGHT: preserve its dim cool-grey/teal ambient light and dark sky, with no added moon, stars, lamps or fireflies. Do not turn it into daylight.
annotation_notes: Final third annotation version; inspect true alpha contours and patched B_all; all masks remain same-canvas source selectors. Retain all previous annotations and QA. No QA thresholds changed.
